test_title: PYST 25: SSC CHSL 2023 - English (Held On: 10 Aug, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
**Select the most appropriate synonym of the underlined word.**

Demand for water is also __rapidly__. rising due to population growth, urbanisation and increasing pressures from the agriculture and energy sector.
solution: The correct answer is '**promptly**'. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The most appropriate synonym of the given word '**Rapidly**' is '**Promptly**'. • **Rapidly**: very quickly; at a great rate. (द्रुत गति से) • *Example: the business is expanding **rapidly**...* • **Promptly**: immediately; without delay. (तुरंत; बिना विलंब किए) • *Example: I invited her to dinner and she **promptly** accepted.* **Correct Answer:__** *Promptly.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • Let's look at the meaning of other words: • **Luxuriously**: in a very comfortable and expensive way. • **Leisurely**: without hurry. (फु़रसत वाला, विश्रामपूर्ण, चैनभरा) • **Hopefully**: hoping that what you want will happen. (आशा करते हुए कि जो हम चाहते हैं वही होगा, अभीष्‍ट परिणाम की आशा करते हुए) 41:T9be, The correct answer is **'C, B, D, A'.**
